summary: Optimize existing Caffeine.ai site for mobile Core Web Vitals/PageSpeed (target 90+ performance) via image, JS/CSS, caching, render-blocking, accessibility contrast, and robots.txt improvements.
architectural_notes: Primary goal: achieve 90+ mobile PageSpeed Performance by addressing LCP (7.5s) and TBT (1,390ms) via image optimization, JS/CSS reduction, caching, and render-blocking elimination.
known_issues: Mobile PageSpeed Performance is 39 with poor LCP (7.5s) and high TBT (1,390ms).
Accessibility issue: insufficient color contrast detected.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- RecomNow logo as WebP (recomnow-logo.dim_200x200.webp)
- RecomNow logo as AVIF (recomnow-logo.dim_200x200.avif)
- Hero banner as WebP (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.webp)
- Hero banner as AVIF (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.avif)

existing_features.title: Replace above-the-fold critical image assets with modern compressed formats and update the app to prefer those formats to improve LCP/FCP without changing layout.

Update `frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.tsx` to deliver responsive, non-blocking images: ensure priority images use `fetchpriority="high"` and eager loading; non-priority images use lazy loading; decoding is async; and WebP/AVIF are preferred with safe PNG fallback.

Eliminate render-blocking and unnecessary work in `frontend/index.html`: update preloads to target the optimized hero asset, keep only truly critical preloads, and ensure analytics remains deferred and does not block first paint.

Fix SEO robots.txt validity by serving a static `robots.txt` from `frontend/public/robots.txt` and ensure it includes a correct sitemap URL for `https://recomnowindia-2gi.caffeine.xyz/sitemap.xml`. Remove or bypass any React-route-based robots response that could cause crawlers to receive HTML/JS instead of plain text.

Fix sitemap delivery by serving a static `sitemap.xml` from `frontend/public/sitemap.xml` so crawlers can fetch XML directly without executing React. Ensure it uses `https://recomnowindia-2gi.caffeine.xyz/` as the base for URLs.

Improve cache efficiency for static assets using the existing service worker in `frontend/public/sw.js`: ensure generated image assets and build assets are cached with an appropriate cache-first or stale-while-revalidate strategy and that old caches are cleaned up reliably to reduce repeat-load transfer size.

Reduce main-thread work and TBT by ensuring heavy UI chunks remain code-split and only load on demand (admin panel, login, blog, toaster), and by removing any remaining production console logging via build configuration.

Resolve accessibility contrast warnings by adjusting the foreground/background color pairings (including muted text and gradient/button states) so text meets WCAG AA contrast on both light and dark themes without changing the overall brand feel.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals improvements on the Caffeine.ai site (images, JS/CSS optimization, caching, render-blocking reduction, main-thread/TBT reduction, accessibility contrast fixes, and valid robots.txt).
